tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand Laravel 13 Boilerplate — a WhatsApp-based personal finance tracker built on Laravel. The AGENTS.md file provides coding guidelines and conventions.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The public/index.php is the HTTP entry point that bootstraps the Laravel kernel. bootstrap/app.php configures routing, middleware, and exception handling.

tour.title: Routing & Middleware
tour.description: routes/web.php defines all web routes including Fortify auth routes and the dashboard. The EnsureTokenIsValid middleware protects API endpoints.

tour.title: Fortify Authentication Actions
tour.description: Fortify action classes in app/Actions/Fortify/ handle user registration, password updates, password resets, and profile information changes. These are the core auth business logic.

tour.title: Custom Fortify Responses
tour.description: Custom response classes override default Fortify behavior for password reset links, password reset confirmations, and email verification views.

tour.title: User Model & Authentication Config
tour.description: The User model supports two-factor authentication and passkeys (WebAuthn). config/fortify.php and config/auth.php configure all authentication features.

tour.title: Service Providers
tour.description: FortifyServiceProvider binds Fortify actions and custom responses. AppServiceProvider handles general application bootstrapping.

tour.title: Database Layer
tour.description: Migrations create users, cache, jobs, passkeys tables with two-factor columns. UserFactory generates test data. DatabaseSeeder coordinates seeding.

tour.title: Blade Views & UI
tour.description: Authentication views (login, register, forgot/reset password, verify email) use a shared auth layout. master.blade.php is the main app layout with Vite assets.

tour.title: Frontend Build Pipeline
tour.description: Vite bundles CSS (Tailwind v4) and JavaScript. vite.config.js configures the Laravel Vite plugin. resources/css/app.css is the Tailwind entry point.

tour.title: Configuration Files
tour.description: Core Laravel config files for app, database, cache, session, queue, mail, filesystems, logging, and services. Each controls a subsystem of the application.

tour.title: Testing with Pest
tour.description: Pest PHP test suite with feature and unit tests. Tests/Pest.php contains global configuration. TestCase.php provides the base test class.
